mentions.title: FIA reveals ADUO results in final review of 2026 F1 season
mentions.summary:
The FIA has announced its final Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities (ADUO) results for the 2026 Formula 1 season, with no changes granted for any of the power unit manufacturers.
From this season, the FIA installed a mechanism in the F1 regulations which allowed power unit manufacturers the ability to make updates, if they fell behind the leading engine, in the form of tokens ...Keep reading

mentions.title: McLaren to bring upgrades to Brazil GP with F1 2027 in mind
mentions.summary:
McLaren will introduce upgrades to its MCL40 Formula 1 car at this weekend’s Brazil Grand Prix, featuring a front wing concept which is expected to feature on its 2027 challenger.

mentions.title: McLaren’s 2027-spec front wing is making its F1 car more predictable
mentions.summary:
McLaren team principal Andrea Stella says the 2027-spec front wing concept introduced on the MCL40 at Formula 1’s Brazilian Grand Prix has improved the car’s driveability and predictability.
The Woking-based outfit launched an upgrade package at Interlagos - featuring not just this front wing but also a rear wing, a beam wing and new floor furniture - after McLaren lost ground to Mercedes ...Keep reading

mentions.title: No F1 engine manufacturers to get extra upgrades after FIA’s third ADUO evaluation | Formula 1
mentions.summary: The FIA's single-seater director Nikolas Tombazis defended F1's ADUO rules but indicated they may be revised in coming seasons.
